en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a peaceful coastal scene: a wooden barn on the left with a few women in long dresses seated by bushes, a small wooden pier extending into the water, and several sailing boats with tall white sails moored along the shoreline. At the bottom there is printed and handwritten text in Swedish, including the place name "Raahe – Brahestad" and a dated message from 1903.
